research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sardine is developing systems for fraud prevention and compliance by analyzing behavioral biometrics and transaction data. Age prediction of end users based on input device data and same person detection of end users based on input device data infer user attributes and continuity from sensor signals. Augmented responses to risk inquiries, transaction evaluation based on a machine learning projection of future account, and risk insights utility for traditional finance and decentralized finance generate risk insights and transaction evaluations. Together these efforts target identity analytics and risk scoring.

overview_description.description: Sardine specializes in providing risk management solutions primarily for the financial services sector. They focus on using artificial intelligence and machine learning to help enterprises manage risks associated with fraud, credit, and compliance. The company aims to serve businesses in the digital economy by offering tools and services that enhance operational efficiency and ensure regulatory compliance.

about_short_description.short_description: Sardine is a fraud prevention and compliance software company for the digital economy.

product.name: Device and Behavior
product.description: Detects fraud by analyzing device intelligence and behavioral biometrics to identify suspicious user activity and prevent financial crime.

product.name: Identity Fraud
product.description: Detects stolen and synthetic identities to prevent fake account sign-ups, money mule activity, and onboarding fraud.

product.name: KYC and KYB
product.description: Performs customer due diligence, business verification, sanctions screening, and document verification in one platform.

product.name: Bank Account Validation
product.description: Verifies bank account ownership and assesses risk levels in real-time to prevent fraud during account funding and transactions.

product.name: Payment Fraud
product.description: Blocks fraudulent card and bank payments and predicts chargebacks and ACH returns in real-time.

product.name: AML Transaction Monitoring
product.description: Detects illicit money movement and streamlines case management and regulatory filings for anti-money laundering compliance.
